1.1.0:
Morse now includes the paddle engine. Choose Audio converter or VBand USB in Settings. One native keyer times the sidetone, the marks you send and paddle typing.

Your sending overlays your marks on the target timing. Correct exercises advance automatically. Send and Listen share speed, spacing, pitch and volume.

Practise offline and export progress from Saved progress. This Mac release keeps progress and scores on your Mac. The live leaderboard, private sync and recovery codes are unavailable.

Settings → Updates shows what’s new and checks for a Mac download. Automatic updates are off by default.
